subject.title: [Security] Prototype Pollution via Deserialization in session transcripts

question: Can an untrusted or sandboxed principal modify transcript records that current OpenClaw later assigns into privileged application objects, or does the report assume same-user arbitrary file access without an unsafe merge sink?
rationale: That trust-boundary distinction determines whether this is a security vulnerability, ordinary local-state tampering, or a false positive; the issue currently provides no evidence resolving it.

options.title: Validate Privately
options.body: Move the technical reproduction to a private advisory and test a concrete payload through the real current-main reader and consumer path.

options.title: Close After Boundary Check
options.body: Close as unsupported if inspection confirms plain JSON parsing with no recursive assignment sink and only same-user arbitrary transcript modification.
